svg.title: Genesis / Run and review
svg.desc: Start on one Linux server. Distribute independent datasets as capacity grows.. Arrows show selected data dependencies; this is not a live execution graph.
svg.text: Start on one Linux server. Distribute independent datasets as capacity grows.
Use existing authenticated access. Healthy jobs continue while failed datasets enter review.
Cluster and SSH deployment require site acceptance. Animation illustrates routes, not live status.
